primary_endpoint: MASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis or improvement in at least one fibrosis stage without worsening of MASH; liver fat reduction was also assessed.
efficacy_outcome: In MASH with moderate-to-advanced fibrosis, GLP-1RAs increased the odds of MASH resolution (OR 3.48, 95% CI 2.69–4.51) and fibrosis improvement (OR 1.79, 95% CI 1.37–2.35) versus placebo. Liver fat decreased (mean difference −4.50%, 95% CI −6.60 to −2.40%); semaglutide did not improve MASH resolution or fibrosis in the single compensated-cirrhosis RCT.
